title: feat(metadata-protocol,cli,cloud-connection)!: the override write gate — only the base's paired .custom declares an override (ADR-0146 D2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNNCo1UH18c8rw38MKwdp8C)_

Fixes #28410

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
New refusals at the save and publish doors, at `os validate` and at the marketplace managed install narrow the accepted set; the base's paired `.custom` declaring an override is admitted beside them. No `packages/spec/**` file changes.

Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches the `overrides` declaration, a `<base>.custom` package or the sealed-write sentence; the `content/docs/references/**` pages that show `overrides` are generated from the spec and do not move.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:覆盖写门(ADR-0146 D2,#28390 裁决 A)落在三个门点:保存/发布门、`os validate`、市场托管安装。只有基础包配对的 `<base>.custom` 能声明 `overrides`;依赖包里与闭包内只读包同名的条目被拒(改名),五类拒绝各有一句(未声明同名、非配对包声明、基础包不在闭包或不含该条目、排除类型、object),flow/action 声明答「尚不可用」。
- 为什么改:依赖包可以在基础包的名字下发布条目,读者拿到哪一份没有定论(#28238 的形状:今天 200)。
- 风险与回滚:收窄只拦闭包内同名与不被接纳的声明;预检计数 hotcrm 与仓内示例为 0 处。码与状态不变(`403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`),未声明同名的拒绝排在各门已有拒绝之后。回滚即 revert,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`(`judgeOverrideWrite`、`overrideWriteItemsOf`),`protocol.ts` 的保存门与 `promoteDraftForPublish` 两处接线,`cloud-connection` 安装门的步骤 2d。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 56 passed (56)`。
- 需要你做的:卡上的安装门点从 `installPackage` 移到市场托管安装(席位已批);另有一个开放问题:`os build` 要不要也拒(见报告)。

## What changes

- **The rule, once** (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`). `judgeOverrideWrite(subject, closure)` is a pure verdict: `admit`, one named `refuse`, or `not_concerned`. It reads N-08's surface from `@objectstack/spec/kernel` (`OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION`, `isCustomizationPairOf`, `customizationPackageId`, `customizationBasePackageId`) and copies none of it. `overrideWriteItemsOf(body)` is the item walk the two outside doors share (an action keyed `<objectName>:<name>`, a `views:` container expanded by the loader's own `expandViewContainer`). Both are exported from the package index in one export line.
- **The refusals**, all `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, each with its own sentence:
  - (a) `undeclared_same_name`: a dependent's item under the name a read-only package in its closure ships, on an overridable type. In `<base>.custom`: "Declare it … or rename the item". Elsewhere: "Rename the item".
  - (b) `declared_outside_pair`: `overrides` on a package that is not the base's pair.
  - (c) `declared_package_outside_closure` ("Declare a dependency on '<base>' …") and `declared_package_ships_no_such_item`.
  - (d) `declared_type_not_overridable`: an excluded type, pointing to a new item under a new name.
  - (e) `declared_object`: pointing to `objectExtensions`.
  - `declared_type_not_yet_available`: a declared `flow` ("flow customization is not yet available") or `action`.
- **Admit.** The pair declaring an override of an item its base ships, on an open type: the save door skips the sealed refusal for it and the repository is told a `runtime-only` write (the pair's own row), at the save and at the promotion.
- **Save and publish doors** (`protocol.ts`). The save door judges every save; a refused declaration throws before the flow-only regime check (so a declared flow reads its own sentence, not the clone sentence), and an undeclared same name throws last, just before the store, so every refusal the door already answered keeps its code and status (a view container's name collision keeps its 400, a lock its `ITEM_LOCKED`). The promotion (`publishMetaItem`, `publishPackageDrafts`) judges the draft body and throws once, last before the store; a batch publish reports it in `failed`.
- **Base = read-only.** Only a package `isWritablePackage` answers false for is a base the gate guards: an override replaces an installed item, and a writable package's item is edited in place (ADR-0070). Every artifact a kernel serves is registered through `registerApp`, which puts it in `manifests`, so this keeps no real base out.
- **The sealed sentence.** On an open type it gains "To change it, declare an override from '<base>.custom' (overrides: { package: '<base>', basedOn }), or rename the item." The base id is read through the existing `packagedArtifactOwner`, so no new `lookupArtifactItem` call site.
- **`os validate`** (`@objectstack/cli`, `utils/override-declarations.ts`, step 3a-iii). Each package of the artifact (or the stack as one package) is judged against its closure, followed through the artifact's packages. A same name is found where both packages are in the artifact; a declaration is judged whole wherever its base lives. Exit 1, the rows on `errors` with `path`, `code`, `rule`, `packageId`, `message`.
- **Marketplace managed install** (`@objectstack/cloud-connection`, step 2d, before any write). Every delivered package (a `packages[]` artifact judged per entry) is judged against its closure (registry dependencies plus the artifact's own) with shippers read from the protocol's per-package listing. A refusal answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` with `details.refusals`; nothing registers and no ledger entry is written. On an install of a base, `overrideCollisions` on the `200` answer lists each name an installed dependent already holds undeclared (the judge's sentence per row); the key is omitted when empty.

## Tests

- `protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts`: the gate describe block, 56 tests in the file. Red first on main (`b24adb3a`): 20 failed, 35 passed.
- `protocol.sealed-remedy-kind.test.ts`: the one-sentence pin reads the declare-or-rename tail from the classification, never transcribed.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/override-declarations.test.ts` (7, unit tier) and `packages/cli/test/validate-override-declarations.test.ts` (2, the command, exit code).
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-override-gate.test.ts` (6): refusals, nothing written, the pair's admit, the control, the collision list.
- `protocol.org-scoped-write-refused.test.ts` is green and unchanged (`git diff 23d1303d -- <file>` empty).
- Ablations, 16, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with its restore proved clean (`git diff HEAD` empty); each reads red: (a) 7 failed, (b) 4, (c) closure 1, (c) ships 1, (d) 1, (e) 1, not-yet 2, sealed tail 5, read-only base filter 127 (the org-scoped file), save door declared throw 4, save door undeclared throw 5, promotion throw 3, admitted runtime-only intent 1, install refusal 3, install collisions 1, validate wiring 1. Two first attempts were no-ops (the anchor's replacement count did not rise) and were redone; one (an early declared throw at the promotion) read green and was removed as redundant.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's `installPackage` gate point moved to the marketplace managed install** (seat 1 amendment, posted on #28410). `installPackage` takes a manifest and no items (`PackageInstallManifestSchema`), and the unmanaged install copies through the save door, which is gated; the managed install is where a package's items arrive unjudged.
- `os build` does not run the gate. The parity ledger records `findOverrideDeclarationRefusals` in `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` with the reason; whether the build refuses too is an open question on the card.
- The validate and install tests live beside their doors, not in `protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts` as the order put it: metadata-protocol cannot import cli or cloud-connection (they depend on it).
- Not handled: a rollback (`rollbackMetaItem`) of a declared override row still computes the `override-artifact` intent from `isArtifactBacked` alone. Rolling back the pair's row is N-10/N-16 territory and not a door this card names.
- The install door's collision list reads dependents through the protocol listing (`getMetaItems({ type, packageId })`), which serves code-registered and stored items alike, so a `.custom` built in Studio is covered.

## Verification

Run on `b9023312` unless a line says otherwise.

- Typecheck: metadata-protocol, cli, cloud-connection, exit 0.
- metadata-protocol full suite after merging `origin/main` (#28507): 288 files passed, 4 skipped; exit 0.
- cloud-connection full suite: 64 files, 774 tests passed.
- cli unit tier: 361 files, green after the parity ledger row; the command test: 2 passed.
- Scoped eslint (`eslint --no-inline-config` on the 12 changed `.ts` files): exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, reconciled with `--ran`): `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Two first reds were this diff's own test double, fixed in `b9023312`: `check:engine-double-contract` (the double now opens `findOne`/`update`/`delete` with the metadata-core dispatch asserts, pinned with `--write`) and `check:objectql-double-limit` (its `find` holds `limit`). `check:plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its fixture commit fetched; `check:type-check-debt` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed a fresh `pnpm install` after the merge (a new connector package) and then read exit 0.
- Dogfood battery on `4bc67b6c` (after a closure rebuild): `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 363 passed | 3 skipped (366), Tests 2932 passed | 28 skipped (2960). The head `b9023312` differs only by the gate test's double and the engine-double ledger JSON, neither on a dogfood path; that test file re-ran 56/56 on `b9023312`.
- Serial check: #28507 merged, so `origin/main` was merged once (clean, no same-logic conflict: it adds the read side, `isServedOverrideRowOf`). `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/claude/project-thread-7yvsri` (#28512 at `c85bce56`) exits 0, no conflict.
